overall_comment: Predictions are based only on structural MRI metadata without DWI/ADC, perfusion, spectroscopy, SWI/GRE, or histology. The strongest uncertainty is the high T2-FLAIR mismatch signal, which supports an IDH-mutant astrocytoma pattern but may be confounded here by the large necrotic/non-enhancing core and enhancing high-grade morphology.
